Sam: Quick heads-up — nightly EU1 capacity run just flagged rapid buffer drain around 02:30 UTC. p99 creeping above 800ms when spot nodes get reclaimed. Attaching short logs and timeline below.

ops-bot: ScheduledReserveRun finished: buffer_util=78% -> 92% over 20m, reclaimed_spot=3, low_prio_evictions=42.

Sylvia: ugh. is this the same noisy-neighbor pattern from last month or new?

Dawson: Different. kernel preemption + network jitter on 10.0.3.x. GPUs show ctx-switch spikes, not just pack evictions. I pulled GPU metrics — see snippet: 
```
gpu_utilization: 65 -> 90
ctx_switch/sec: 320 -> 980
kv_cache_miss: +12%
```

Ravi: Quick back-of-envelope: our p99 latency target is 500ms. With observed service time med ~120ms and variance, keeping 10% warm buffer at peak gives us ~6 extra GPUs for EU1 tonight => ~144 GPU-hours. Cost ~= $360/night (spot/reserve mix).

Kiara: Can we temporarily reroute low-priority traffic to us-east to avoid user impact? Need to check data residency — only safe for non-PII routes. Also suggest lowering admit_rate hysteresis during reclaim windows (example: `admit_rate_threshold: 0.75 -> 0.55`).

Sam: I can spin a canary routing rule to us-east for low-priority model variants. Will need a quick rollback plan. @Sylvia any objections on data residency/enterprise contracts?

Sylvia: Fine as long as we limit to embeddings and non-PII text-only endpoints. Cost hit is acceptable for one-off nights, but make sure invoices are tracked. Also flag for Black Friday planning — seasonal demand will amplify drain.

Dawson: We should run a small queueing sim rather than only heuristic math. Rough M/M/c estimate: p99 latency ~ service_time * (1 + (rho^(sqrt(2(c+1))-1))/(1-rho)) — crude but helpful to size headroom. I'll validate with trace-driven sim.

Ravi: I'll run the sim with recent traffic trace (90th percentile sequence length 128, batching factor ~1.7) and post numbers by EOD. If sims say reserve >=8 GPUs, we should pre-allocate.

Kiara: I'll update the runbook with emergency routing + admit adjustments. Proposed routing snippet: 
```
- match: route.labels.priority=="low"
  action: failover("eu1", fallback_region:"us-east-1", allow_non_pii:true)
  conditions:
    - eu1.buffer_pct > 85
    - reclaim_events_last_30m >= 2
```

Sam: Action items: Ravi run sim and confirm GPU-hours; Kiara update runbook and push gating tests; Dawson validate kernel preemption causes; Sam implement canary rule (with immediate rollback). I'll open a short RFC for temporary reserve tonight and tag finance. :thumbsup:

Sylvia: thanks — and if sims show >10 GPUs needed, loop in finance before we spin anything.

Ravi: noted. will post sim output + recommended reserve count.

ops-bot: Incident note created: #INC-2026-EU1-BUFFER. Assigned: Sam, Dawson, Ravi.

Sam: Perfect. I'll keep thread updated with rollout progress.
